pairs.description: Cat's claw stimulates immune cell activity and may counteract the therapeutic immunosuppression achieved by cyclosporine.
pairs.mechanism: Oxindole alkaloids stimulate interleukin and tumor necrosis factor release, opposing calcineurin inhibition.

pairs.description: Cat's claw contains rhynchophylline which lowers blood pressure and may induce additive hypotension with antihypertensive drugs.
pairs.mechanism: Blockade of L-type calcium channels and endothelial nitric oxide stimulation by rhynchophylline.

pairs.description: Cat's claw inhibits CYP3A4 enzymes and can alter the pharmacokinetic profile and blood concentrations of protease inhibitors.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of cytochrome P450 3A4-mediated oxidation by pentacyclic oxindole alkaloids.
